items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: I heard this thing -- I was on 51st Street and I was sitting up eating dinner one night, and I heard this music come over the radio, and I listened and I said, 'That don't sound like the band, but he's certainly playing the arrangements.' And this was Dave Pell.

ctx.x: Wasn't that a fellow named Dave Pell?
Oh, maybe it was Dave Pell.
